title: Petition of the Town of Wakefield Municipal Light Department for authorization and approval of an increase in the rate of depreciation from the statutory rate of three percent to five percent for the year 1990.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Werlin, Tierney, Alexander (90-11-D).
Petition of Wakefield Municipal Light Department for authorization and approval of an increase in depreciation rate, on the cost of plant from 3% to 5% for the year of 1990.
